heuristics.statement: The first blocks M0 are fresh uniform 512-bit strings and their chaining values cv = F_38(IV, M0) behave as independent uniform 256-bit values. Consequences used: (a) for every a0, F(a0)=Cc2+a0+k0+h(a0) is uniform and independent of h(a0) and of the epoch table; hence y=R16H[0]-r-F(a0) is uniform, a window probes with probability 26/8192, a probe makes 20 reads, the expected claw count of an a0 is 160*E/2^32 for the table's E retained entries (Lemma C), and a claw's a1 = u-h(a0) is uniform and independent of the claw event, so a claw passes C1 with probability 1/8; (b) given the epoch's table, the works W_j and success counts X_j of distinct chaining values are independent (Lemma 3). For each retained entry H1 gives 160/2^32 expected claws and 20/2^32 expected C1 claws per scanned a0. Every bucket holds a prefix of at most six lanes; weights 6,6,6,8,8,8 sum to at most 7p. Thus the ordered-tree mean charge is at most 7 per C1 claw for every fixed table.

heuristics.statement: A good pair of the u-table procedure is accepted by step 3b with probability q3r >= q3_P1 x 2^32 / 160 = 2^-71.4010, where q3_P1 = 2^-96.0791 = q3_model x 2^D_LB: q3_model = 2^-96.0133 is the registered accepted-event rate of the A0-variant good pairs on P8 before row 16 and D_LB = -0.0658 is the registered one-sided 99% lower bound of the paired per-seed difference L(P1)-L(A0) measured with the P1 law of W9. Every a0 the procedure scans lies in W9, its claws' a1 are uniform (H1) and its good pairs have the measured (a0,a1) law; their u=W1 is retained from the fixed R*=8174 residue classes under the strengthened H7 premise (Lemma S). Two inherited transfer premises are part of this heuristic: (a) the relaxation gain (+0.41488 bit for not imposing E18=E17) measured on the A0-variant family is the same for the P1 family; (b) q3 does not depend on the re-weighting of a1 by its G count.

heuristics.scope: The Bonferroni factor is the constant 1-2^-8.5 = 0.99723786413599... per chaining value: E[J(J-1)]/2 <= 2^-8.5 E[J], and with E[J]=NA*ca_lo*q_pf*q3r the absolute loss is far below the reserved margin. The factor multiplies E[J] once and carries no E[J] inside the correction.
heuristics.statement: Group independence within a chaining value: good pairs of one chaining value that share no endpoint (a0 or u) are independent trials of the accepted event, each with probability q3r; good pairs sharing an endpoint form a group counted once. Consequence used: for a uniform chaining value and any table, J (accepted good pairs among all claws of the chaining value) has E[J(J-1)] <= 2^-7.5 E[J]. This filing applies the same premise to the kept-CV class ((cv0 >> 24) & 63 == 12): the class conditions only cv[0], the registered panel is drawn from uniform chaining values (so about 1/64 of its CVs are in-class), and the transfer of the second-moment bound to the class-conditioned law is part of this declared premise.

restrictions: Target sha256-r38-prefix-v1 exactly: SHA-256 steps 0..37 on every padded block, the standard IV once, FIPS 180-4 padding, feed-forward, all eight digest words. Output: two distinct 128-byte messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' (common first block; FIPS padding appends the same third block) with equal digests; step 3b accepts a pair only if A34..A37, E34..E37 of both members are equal, so every output is a collision (Lemma 1, proof.md Section 1).

Retain one relative column (column 0) before outcomes. NCOL=1, coverage G(u) mod 8192 < 8, probe limit 13, 2^19 compact 30-byte records plus a 32-byte terminal pad, six ordered 39-bit lanes and first-six cyclic retention. Each lane is u32, a carry gap and six field bits; count is at bit 234. SEL, kept CV class, front end, combined predicate, ordered walk, postfilters and step3b are unchanged. No codec, map or second resident pass is used.
